family: For every integer n>=0, MOD5_n(x)=1 exactly when the Hamming weight of its n-bit input is divisible by 5, including MOD5_0(empty)=1.
theorem: For this fixed polynomial-time family in NP with empty witnesses, every full-B2 circuit computing MOD5_n has at least 2n-9 gates for every integer n>=5; consequently liminf over all integer n of C_B2(MOD5_n)/n is at least 2.
